What it is

Version 1 SEAR in GIN: verify while generating

A custom llama-cpp-python logits processor constrains every token at decode time to continue a span that occurs verbatim in the retrieved corpus. Text the corpus does not contain cannot be generated in the first place.

  • BUILT GIN's SEAR layer constrains every generated token, at decode time, to continue a span that occurs verbatim in the retrieved corpus, using a custom llama-cpp-python logits processor. #gin-sear-decode-constraint
  • MEASURED On a 20-query synthetic eval set, SEAR's no-continuation arm produced no fabricated claims, while a plain RAG arm on the same set fabricated about a quarter of its claims. #gin-nc-baseline
  • MEASURED On six two-node queries over excerpts of public institutional and advocacy texts, the no-continuation arm kept both sides of each divergence and fabricated nothing, with Mistral-7B and with Qwen2.5-7B. #gin-divergence-realtext

These entries live on the GIN page and are counted under GIN.

Version 2 sear-demo: verify after generating

The model writes freely. Each claim must then be entailed by its cited chunk (NLI), and every name and number must appear in that chunk, or the claim is dropped. When nothing survives, an explicit failure state replaces a guess.

  • BUILT sear-demo is a corpus-grounded answer pipeline with a verification gate: the model writes freely, then each claim must be entailed by its cited chunk (NLI) and every name and number must appear in it, or the claim is dropped; an explicit failure state replaces guessing. #sear-demo-pipeline
  • BUILT On its 27-probe main set, sear-demo refused all 9 probes that should be refused, but 5 of its 14 failure states were on probes that had a supportable answer. #sear-demo-results
  • NEGATIVE-RESULT When two retrieved chunks contradict each other, sear-demo does not notice: in 4 of 5 conflict probes it silently stated one value, each time the one the model knew from memory. #sear-conflict-fork

The rest of this page covers this version; the counts on this page and on Home are its entries only.

Open questions

  • Can the gate tell when two cited chunks contradict each other? from #sear-conflict-fork
    Would resolve it: A conflict detector, measured on the conflict fork.
  • Which of the review's measurement gaps are fixed? from #sear-review-gaps
    Would resolve it: The review document and a per-item status from the author.
  • What happens when retrieval actually has to choose? from #sear-demo-results
    Would resolve it: A corpus large enough that top_k leaves most chunks out.
